bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
test -d "$root"
units=$(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | awk '{print $1}' | while read -r u; do systemctl --user cat "$u" 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq 'theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV' && printf '%s\n' "$u" || :; done)
n=$(printf '%s\n' "$units" | grep -c . || :)
test "$n" -eq 1 || exit 61
unit="$units"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit" || exit 62
pid=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p MainPID --value)
test "$pid" -gt 1 || exit 63
test -d "/proc/$pid" || exit 64
before=$(cat "/proc/$pid/io" 2>/dev/null | awk '/^(rchar|wchar|read_bytes|write_bytes):/{s+=$2}END{print s+0}')
sleep 4
after=$(cat "/proc/$pid/io" 2>/dev/null | awk '/^(rchar|wchar|read_bytes|write_bytes):/{s+=$2}END{print s+0}')
count=$(find "$root" -type f \( -iname '*.mp4' -o -iname '*.mkv' -o -iname '*.webm' -o -iname '*.mov' -o -iname '*.avi' \) | wc -l)
printf 'TARGET_ACTIVE=1\nPID=%s\nIO_BEFORE=%s\nIO_AFTER=%s\nVIDEO_EXTENSION_FILES=%s\n' "$pid" "$before" "$after" "$count"
test "$after" -gt "$before" || exit 65
